newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 100,000 tonnes of wheat for sale.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 100,000 tonnes of wheat for sale.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) has offered 100,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for sale, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.
He said an international call for prices with October 1 as the final date for offers had already been issued.
Confirmation would be made on October 2.
The amount would be ready for shipment in November, he added.
The GCEPT spokesman said the 100,000 tonnes offer was a replacement for the previous offer issued on September 3 of 100,000 tonnes which was cancelled.
He said price offers were not appropriate and the company had to cancel the offer.
